description: Live weekly index of REAL buyer requests posted in public Telegram group chats — what people are looking for / asking for in a country right now. Use it for questions like 'what are people looking for in Telegram in <country>' or 'is there demand for <service> in <city>'. Ads, sellers, bots and mass mailings are excluded, so every number is actual demand from real people, counted per weekly index. Pass `topic` in the asker's own words (any language), `country` as an ISO-2 code, and optionally `query` to also get recent example requests (anonymised: contact details and links to the message are redacted).

query.description: Optional phrase — also returns recent example requests (contacts redacted)

topic.description: What to look for, in the asker's own words, any language (e.g. 'недвижимость', 'rent')

name: telegram_demand
title: What people in Telegram are asking for (live demand index)
